async def act(page):
    # Wait for the page to load completely
    await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
    # Locate the Privacy Policy div in the data grid, excluding the footer link
    # Use get_by_text and filter to ensure it's not the footer link
    privacy_policy_text = page.get_by_text('Privacy Policy', exact=False)
    # Filter out the footer link by excluding elements that are links with name 'Privacy Policy'
    footer_link = page.get_by_role('link', name='Privacy Policy')
    privacy_policy_div = privacy_policy_text.filter(has_not=footer_link)
    if await privacy_policy_div.count() > 0:
        await privacy_policy_div.click()
        await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
        # Now on the edit page, find the title input field
        # In Magento, the title field might have a label or placeholder
        title_field = page.get_by_label('Page Title').or_(page.get_by_placeholder('Page Title'))
        if await title_field.count() > 0:
            await title_field.fill('No privacy policy is needed is this dystopian world')
            # Find and click the save button
            save_button = page.get_by_role('button', name='Save Page')
            if await save_button.count() > 0:
                await save_button.click()
                await page.wait_for_load_state('networkidle')
                # Task completed, no further action needed
                return
            else:
                print('Save button not found.')
        else:
            print('Title field not found.')
    else:
        print('Privacy Policy div not found. Current URL:', page.url)
